headline: Operations Resume at Hitachi Astemo After Cyber Incident
body: Following a ransomware attack, Hitachi Astemo Automotive Powertrain Technologies (Dongguan) Ltd. has resumed operations at its affected facilities. The attack had forced the company to halt production temporarily as it engaged cybersecurity teams to address the breach. Hitachi Astemo, a significant supplier in the automotive industry, has assured stakeholders that the situation is under control. The company has implemented additional security measures to prevent future incidents and is working diligently to ensure full operational capability.
